page.notes: Two woodcut coin roundels: the left shows a tree with leaves, the right shows a censer or altar with flames. Samaritan letters are rendered with approximate Unicode characters, and each is marked [?] because the scan is too small to confirm them. The thirteen letters after "tantum 13. scil." are only a count from the image. The second line of the Samaritan series may need checking. Printed spacing "affirmantOrigines" and "Ezech.etiam" is left as printed.
